description: Fails on master: one 7-Eleven tagged name:th=Guitar gives the brand the alternative name Guitar, so 'guitar' lists every 7-Eleven. Only the POI that really carries the name should stay. The extract thailand_brand_translations is cut out of Thailand_asia_2.obf: the POIs nearest to Bangkok of each brand and up to 5 POIs per alternative name that produce it (the name of the POI equals the brand and one of its name:xx is that alternative).
